summary: Amorphous TiN films were deposited on a p-type Si substrate using atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) with TEMAT and NH3 as precursors at temperatures between 150 and 220 8C. The deposited TiN films showed excellent step coverage and uniformity for trenches with high aspect ratios. The study investigated the diffusion-barrier properties of TiN films against Cu and Si, finding that annealing up to 600 8C maintained the initial composition, while higher temperatures led to interdiffusion.
